faq_heading: Cape Horn houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Cape Horn. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Cape Horn, Coquitlam: 18 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 7 of 23 Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Cape Horn rose from 14 in June to 18 in September (+28.6%), and 8 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 4.2% of Coquitlam’s 425 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Cape Horn?
Cape Horn also had 13 condos and townhomes listed and 0 sold in September, against 18 houses listed. The Cape Horn condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Cape Horn home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

18 houses sold in Cape Horn with a median price of $1,332,500 (the middle half sold between $1,107,500 and $1,384,000), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 22% sold above list. They had a median $551 per square foot, a median year built of 1982 and a median lot of 7,333 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Cape Horn?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 18 houses listed in Cape Horn. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Cape Horn a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Cape Horn had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Cape Horn from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses sold in Cape Horn over those 4 months, out of 219 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Cape Horn?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Cape Horn sell for?
faq.a: 18 houses sold in Cape Horn between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,332,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Cape Horn?
faq.a: The median was 22 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.0% of the last list price (22% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
